# OBS Studio attribution

SkyLive is an independent Rust experiment inspired by and containing adaptations and resources from [OBS Studio](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio). OBS Studio and its contributors retain their respective copyright. The original OBS license is GNU GPL version 2 or later; its GPL version 2 text is included in this repository as [LICENSE](../../LICENSE). See also the source files and [third-party notices](../../assets/licenses/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md) for component-specific attribution and licenses.

[AUTHORS](AUTHORS) is the author and contributor list from the local OBS Studio reference checkout. It is retained as an upstream attribution, not a claim that everyone listed contributed to SkyLive.

[COMMITMENT](COMMITMENT) is the GPL Cooperation Commitment from that OBS checkout, preserved as an upstream historical document. Its terms identify the contributors to whom it applies; its inclusion here does not assert that subsequent SkyLive contributors or the SkyLive maintainer have made the same commitment.

The local OBS checkout used for research is not included in this repository. The upstream source is available from the link above; individual notices and provenance files in this repository identify selected adaptations and resources.
